name: Shoji no Osugi

location.address: Suwa Shrine, Shoji, Fujikawaguchiko, Minamitsuru District, Yamanashi Prefecture
location.neighbourhood: Shoji (Lake Shoji area, Fuji Five Lakes)

access: Free. Stands within the grounds of Suwa Shrine, open to the public.
transport: In the Shoji district by Lake Shoji, one of the Fuji Five Lakes; reached by car or local bus from Kawaguchiko or Fujinomiya.
verify_notes: Standalone destination tree, the sacred tree (goshinboku) of Suwa Shrine in the Shoji district by Lake Shoji, one of the Fuji Five Lakes. Also known locally as 'Sennen-sugi' (Thousand-Year Cedar). Designated National Natural Monument on 31 January 1928. Height 40m, trunk girth 12.0m, estimated age roughly 1,200 years, among the largest cedars in Yamanashi Prefecture. Sits within day-trip range of the wider Mount Fuji Five Lakes tourist area. No explicit recent health note found in the sources checked; flagged for that gap only, nothing suggesting decline was found.
